output.reason: The changelog line alone is vague, but the linked issue and PR spell it out. The subject is Argo CD's built-in Lua health check for Policy resources from policy.open-cluster-management.io, in resource_customizations/policy.open-cluster-management.io/Policy/health.lua [ev-9a623c2087ce]. The change adds a missing nil check on status.placement before its length is checked [ev-73fe59d813f3]. Exposure and consequence are stated: when a Policy has an empty, non-nil status ({}), for example a policy not attached to any placement, the health check throws a Lua `__len` error instead of returning a health status. The bug was introduced in 2.14 by #21297 [ev-587d539c4579, ev-983d523ac8b5].
